$comment: Single source of truth for the website's languages. URLs, redirects, the navbar switcher,
sitemap and hreflang alternates, metadata, the docs sidebar fallback and the translation
checks all derive from this file. scripts/locales.mjs validates every entry.
To add a language: add one entry here, then follow TRANSLATIONS.md → Adding a language.
code: must equal the key; used in URLs (/de/...) and content file names (intro.de.mdx).
names.en / names.tr: how the switcher labels this language in the English and Turkish UIs.
nativeName: the language's own name (docs UI, llms.txt).
dir: ltr or rtl. rtl sets dir="rtl" on <html>; mirroring the layouts is a follow-up.
enabled: false declares a prepared language without routing or listing it. A disabled
language may not have content files yet; enable it when its translation lands (#112-#114).
docs: required = every page must exist; optional = missing pages fall back to English.
contribGuide: true only for a translated CONTRIBUTING.<code>.md; socialImage overrides
